mentions.name: Selora Homes
mentions.description: Managed smart-home service providing professional installation and ongoing support for Home Assistant. Subscribers receive a pre-installed smart hub (a miniPC) and installers handle physical setup, while the team remotely configures devices, automations, and a dashboard. Management access is maintained over WireGuard with traffic closed by default, remote support requires owner approval, and subscribers stay admins of their own instance. The hub pulls config updates from a public GitLab repo, and the service covers monitoring, troubleshooting, and upcoming automatic updates with health-aware rollbacks. An AI agent to help maintain configs and suggest automations is in development. Open core, backed by Open Core Ventures, with source code on GitLab and a public roadmap; currently recruiting beta testers in California and offering a free tier.
mentions.problem: Home Assistant is powerful but requires ongoing maintenance that most people can't or don't want to handle; enthusiasts will run it for their own homes but not for parents, friends, etc.
mentions.audience: Households who want the power of Home Assistant without maintaining it themselves, including HA enthusiasts' parents and friends; currently recruiting beta testers in California (Bay Area and SoCal).
